svg.title: Sara Monteiro animated ASCII research footer
svg.desc: Transparent GitHub README footer cycling every seven seconds through neuroscience, neuroimaging, machine learning, network science and profile visuals. Each ASCII illustration self-types row by row with a terminal cursor, then remains still until the next state.

g.text: computational methods for complex biomedical data
quantifying topology, structure and information flow
GRAPH METRICS · INFORMATION THEORY · COMMUNITY DETECTION
bridging clinical science, computation and infrastructure
